consequence: This widget cannot be migrated in this cycle. It must keep react-aria-components, or the feature must be deferred until a Base UI release exports date components. Do not attempt to rebuild a calendar on internals/temporal — no public widget, no docs, no consumers in the shipped bundle.
notableDifferences: React Aria's calendar stack is keyed on DateValue objects from @internationalized/date (CalendarDate, CalendarDateTime, ZonedDateTime) via react-stately; Base UI 1.8.0 has no equivalent and its internal temporal scaffolding expects a registered adapter object (date-fns/luxon), not an @internationalized/date value — so a future port is a data-model migration, not just a component swap.

Repo styling relies on RAC render-prop cell state (isSelected/isSelectionStart/isFocusVisible/isOutsideMonth) and on Tailwind's `selected:`-family variants; neither has a Base UI counterpart for a calendar.
